description: This file defines the TreeRule class, which extends AbstractRule and manages hierarchical rule evaluation in an AWS endpoint decision process. It includes methods for constructing rules, evaluating them with recursion, and storing the rule set.

classes.name: TreeRule
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractRule to evaluate hierarchical rules structured as trees, recursively processing subordinate rules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a TreeRule instance with a given set of rules, initializing the rule set.

methods.name: getRules
methods.description: Returns the list of rules associated with this TreeRule.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the input parameters against the tree of rules, recursing into subordinate rules if conditions are met.

methods.name: createRules
methods.description: Creates rule objects from an array of rule definitions using RuleCreator.
